changelog:
CometOS Emerald Bay 27.1.1 brings a set of apps, a new Control Center and a matching lock screen, and makes Software Update more dependable.

Apps:
- Mail, Calendar, Notes, Clock, Weather, Photo Booth, Voice Memos, Podcasts, Books, Maps and Freeform
- Pages, Numbers, Keynote and iMovie
- Font Book, Keychain Access, Console, Digital Color Meter, Grapher, Image Capture, Screen Sharing and Storage
- AirDrop and Messages work with your phone
- Safari takes on a Safari-inspired look

Desktop:
- Redesigned Control Center with pill toggles, sound and brightness sliders, and Now Playing
- Lock screen displays your picture, with the password field appearing over a blurred wallpaper when typing begins
- Larger Dock and menu bar, with the full Trash icon visible in the Dock
- macOS Tahoe-inspired app icons, including dark variants for dark appearance
- Terminal uses a dark appearance by default

System:
- Printing and scanning, with automatic discovery of network printers
- Time Machine backups, firewall, VoiceOver, Quick Look in Finder, Touch ID support with fingerprint readers, and firmware updates
- Software Update can resume after dropped connections and displays release notes before updating
